system.notes:
Grief Wail (d6 to everyone Nearby; RESOLVE test for half). Immune to normal weapons — silver and magic strike true.

The frozen memory of one of Morwenna's four founding friends, replaying her last attempt to save the Queen. Use the statblock four ways: the Shieldmaiden (guards the gate), the Gardener (the briar court), the Songkeeper (the banquet hall), the Cartographer (the map room).

Each Echo can be freed instead of fought: show the Silver Rose Pin and speak to it as the friend it was (WITS or RESOLVE test). A freed Echo restores one spent Heart Die to each hero and whispers one true thing about Morwenna — the four whispers together reveal the save-her path.
